title: Capitalizing On China’s Data Advantage In AI

Capitalizing On China’s Data Advantage In AI

Laila Khawaja

Gavekal Technologies: Chips | 8 Oct 2026

Abundant data is often considered a Chinese advantage in AI: China’s vast consumer market and industrial base generate a lot of data and potential AI use cases. Yet data availability does not equal usability. Much of China’s data is fragmented, unlabeled, non-standardized, and confined within government and corporate silos. Beijing sees the problem and is leading a nationwide effort to collect, process, govern, share, and trade high-quality datasets. It wants to enable companies to create data flywheels that would strengthen China’s AI capabilities. The strategy is coherent in theory, but hard to execute.
